Method of Attack: consent phishing attack via malicious Office 365 OAuth apps
tricking users into granting permissions to attacker-controlled OAuth apps
Attack Vector: malicious OAuth 2.0 web apps registered by attackers
Indicators of Compromise: Domains used to host malicious OAuth apps: officeinvetorys[.]com, officehnoc[.]com, officesuited[.]com, officemtr[.]com, officesuitesoft[.]com, mailitdaemon[.]com
